From the reflection, \(m=n+1\) and
\[
2a+6b \equiv \frac{90}{7} \pmod m.
\]
Since \(n=2a+6b\), we have \(n=m-1\), so
\[
m-1 \equiv \frac{90}{7} \pmod m.
\]
Multiplying by \(7\):
\[
7m-7 \equiv 90 \pmod m
\]
so
\[
-7 \equiv 90 \pmod m \quad\Rightarrow\quad 97 \equiv 0 \pmod m.
\]
Thus \(m\mid 97\). Since \(a,b\) are positive, \(n=2a+6b>0\), so \(m=n+1>1\). Therefore \(m=97\), giving \(n=96\).

\[
\boxed{96}
\]
